question: What condition affects even the wise at the tip of nectar and essence?
premises: The tip of nectar is involved
The tip of essence is involved
Even the wise one is burning
inference: Even a wise person experiences burning at the tip of nectar and essence.
uncertainties: The physiological or yogic referent of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa is unclear.
plain_english: Even the wise one burns at the tip of nectar, at the tip of essence.
